correctness.rationale: All admissible lengths and zero-gap boundaries are covered. A direct shift change (increase by the number of zeros after a leading one, decrease by three after a leading zero) yields \((X^3-1)P=(X^n-1)Q\). Cancellation recovers the unordered root triple; the root-to-gap matrix has determinant 9. The one remaining inverse is \((2m/3-c,2m/3-b,2m/3-a)\), integral iff \(3\mid n\) and nonnegative iff \(\max\{a,b,c\}\le2h\). A Burnside count of admissible cyclic triples \((h^2+h+1)\) and fixed orbits \((2h+1)\) proves exactly \(\binom h2\) two-source fibers and the overall spectrum count. The independent finite literal verifier passed 276 necklaces up to length eighteen, and an exact gap census passed 31,780 cyclic triples up to length eighty-four. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The novelty-bearing statement is the inverse-fiber classification of a multiset of complete 2-binomial signatures over all rotations of a three-one binary necklace, including its exact divisibility-by-three doubleton count and reflection-complement partner map. The closest published source supplies bounds on within-orbit distinct fingerprints; Brunetti gives only congruence properties for cyclic inversion statistics, and Rigo/Lejeune concern ordinary binomial equivalence classes. These do not state or imply the cross-necklace inverse-fiber census. The assessment is best-knowledge, not proof of absolute historical priority.
residual_risks: An earlier unindexed cyclic inversion-spectrum classification may exist under a different name; retrieval is not a proof of priority.

value.rationale: The full inverse-multiplicity spectrum answers a natural question about reconstruction from a cyclic multiset of scattered-subsequence observations, at the smallest nontrivial sparse weight beyond two markers. It gives an explicit source-mate map, a divisibility-by-three phase transition in identifiability, the first ambiguous length nine, and an all-length exact capacity \((n/3)^2\) when the length is divisible by three. This is more than computing a marginal or finite slice; the structural involution is the reason for the entire count. Higher weights, noise and partial measurements are explicitly excluded.
